LONG_DESCRIPTION: The Vietnam Smart Grid Development and Implementation Reverse Trade Mission (RTM) familiarized key power sector officials from Ho Chi Minh City Power Corporation (EVN HCMC) with the latest advances in U.S. smart grid and power transmission technologies and practices, and connected U.S. businesses to opportunities in Vietnam. SHORT_DESCRIPTION: TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE - WIND GRID CODE DEVELOPMENT AND RENEWABLE INTEGRATION STUDY, THROUGH GENERAL ELECTRIC COMPANY
PROJECT_TITLE: Technical Assistance - Wind Grid Code Development and Renewable Integration Study, through General Electric Company
LONG_DESCRIPTION: This $287,917 technical assistance (TA) grant supported the development of a modern grid interconnection code in Vietnam that specifically includes the intermittent and distributed nature of wind power generation in Vietnam's power grid to assist the successful integration of new wind generation.  The TA examined connection requirements and the impacts of wind power generation on the power system, system stability, and reliability from the perspective of generation capacity.  The U.S. contractor for the activity also considered and recommended possible market design to reflect increasing renewable energy operations.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE - PHU CUONG 1 WIND FARM PROJECT, THROUGH ENTERPRISE - UNITED STATES UNKNOWN
PROJECT_TITLE: Technical Assistance - Phu Cuong 1 Wind Farm Project, through Enterprise - United States Unknown
LONG_DESCRIPTION: This feasibility study grant is funding a detailed implementation plan for a 170 megawatt (MW) wind power project in Vietnam. The study will assist the Phu Cuong Group Corporation (PCG), a private sector company in Vietnam, in its efforts to build and develop multiple, near-offshore wind power projects along the countrys southern coastline. The first of these projects will be the 170 MW Phu Cuong 1 Wind Farm, which will provide electricity to local customers in Soc Trang province. If implemented, the project would support Vietnams energy and power sector in prioritizing the increase of renewable energy production.

SHORT_DESCRIPTION: RENEWABLE ENERGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMME
PROJECT_TITLE: Renewable Energy Development Programme
LONG_DESCRIPTION: VN: WB Renewable Energy Development Proj. Vietnam experiences growing electricity demand and has struggled over the last decade to expand the system enough in order to meet this demand. The Government recognizes the potential for renewable energy to contribute to the sustainable development of the electricity sector and has made a solid start with the Renewable Energy Action Plan (adopted 2001). Nevertheless, further efforts need to be made in order to overcome still existing barriers to large scale development of grid connected renewable energy sources. The Renewable Energy Development Project aims to increase the supply of renewable energy to the national grid. A refinancing loan facility will be made available to selected Vietnamese banks, which will give credit to private project developers of eligible renewable energy based projects. Technical assistance is foreseen for the capacity building of the banks, but also for developing a regulatory framework to strengthen renewable energy and for developing a project pipeline. SECO co-finances this World Bank Project with a grant contribution to the technical assistance.
